info.name: Ecommerce API - Full Flow (with dummy data)
info.description:
Complete, ordered test flow for the expressJs_ecommerce_backend backend.

HOW TO USE
1. Import this collection AND 'Ecommerce.postman_environment.json'.
2. Select the 'Ecommerce - Local' environment (top-right).
3. Start the server (npm run server) -> http://localhost:3000.
4. Run the folders top to bottom (or click 'Run collection').
   Tokens and IDs (adminToken, userToken, productId, addressId, orderId...) are saved automatically by test scripts.

TOKENS
- adminToken: from '1.1 Admin Login' (ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env)
- userToken:  from '1.2 Register New User' (a unique email is generated each run)

Seeded dummy users (password Test@1234): rahul.verma@example.com, priya.singh@example.com, amit.kumar@example.com

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Login admin, register a fresh user, check /me.

request.description: To log in as a seeded user instead, use rahul.verma@example.com / Test@1234.

item.name: 2. Products
item.description: Public listing + admin CRUD. Images can be URLs (JSON) or files (form-data).

request.description: Saves the 1st and 3rd product IDs as productId / productId2.

item.name: 3. Addresses
item.description: A user can have multiple addresses; isDefault=true unsets the others.

item.name: 4. Wishlist
item.description: Toggle adds if missing, removes if present.

item.name: 5. Cart
item.description: Cart items are matched by productId + size.

item.name: 5.2 Add To Cart (product 1, size M x2)
5.3 Add To Cart (product 2, size S x1)

request.description: Empties the cart. Run AFTER placing the order, or the order step will fail with 'Cart is empty'.

item.name: 6. Orders
item.description: Order is built from the current cart. Re-run 5.2 before creating another order.

request.description: Makes sure the cart isn't empty (5.8 clears it).

item.name: 8. Payments (Stripe test mode)
item.description: Only mounted when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set. Open the returned url to pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

item.name: 9. Cleanup
item.description: Deletes the test data this run created (keeps the seeded dummy data).
